facts.value: Before applying, we recommend you to inform yourself about your desired degree program.
For undergraduate programs at Goethe University, there are various application paths.
You can apply for a total of three degree programs at Goethe University at the same time.
If you are already enrolled and seeking to change subjects or pursue a double degree, please refer to the further links at the end of this page.
Check your emails and the Goethe-Campus portal regularly and submit your documents early and completely to secure your study place stress-free.
Once you receive an admission offer (depending on the degree program via Hochschulstart or directly in Goethe-Campus), you can/must enroll at Goethe University within the enrollment deadline.
Be sure to pay attention to notifications via email and regularly check your user account at Hochschulstart or in Goethe-Campus.
The enrollment takes place either online via the Goethe-Campus portal or by sending documents via email, depending on the respective degree program.
Detailed information about deadlines and procedures can be found in the admission notice or directly in Goethe-Campus.
